# tenferro v0.13.0

v0.13.0 follows v0.12.0 (published 2026-11-19). Below 1.0 a breaking change moves
the minor version, and this release removes a few public items from
`tenferro-runtime`, so read it as a breaking release for the callers of those
items. The call grammar of v0.12.0 is unchanged. The vendor BLAS/LAPACK removal
([#2609](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2609)) already shipped in
v0.12.0.

## Breaking changes

- The custom compiler-pass API is removed from `tenferro_runtime::program`:
  `SemanticTransform`, `SemanticTransformContext`, `TransformIdentity` and
  `SemanticTransformError`
  ([#2689](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2689)). AD keeps its
  own transforms.
- `tenferro_runtime::ad_support::ones_tensor` and
  `tenferro_runtime::composite::scalar_tensor` are removed. Use
  `Tensor::ones(dtype, shape)` and `Tensor::full(dtype, [0_usize; 0], value)`
  ([#2656](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2656)).
- Every semantic-program fingerprint value changes with the `v2` program
  identity ([#2707](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2707)).
  Fingerprints are process-local cache keys; nothing persists them.

## Features

- `zeros`, `ones` and `full` on `Tensor`, `TraceContext` and `EagerSession`
  ([#2656](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2656)).
- Recorded sub-programs: `TraceContext::record` returns a `RecordedProgram`
  whose identity does not depend on the data it captured
  ([#2707](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2707)).
- `FftExecutor`'s allocating transforms take any `AsView` input
  ([#2695](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2695)), and the FFTs
  have reusable overwrite destinations
  ([#2665](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2665)).

## Performance

- CUDA `vdot_read` is one cuBLAS conjugate dot
  ([#2638](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2638)).
- A CUDA launch returns without draining the stream per operation
  ([#2667](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2667)).

## Fixes

- `full` accepts every exactly representable integer and checks its shape
  before allocating
  ([#2698](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2698)).
- Concrete `cast`/`convert` read their operand once, and the layout
  documentation no longer claims a non-owned receiver is gathered first: a
  strided view is read in place on CPU
  ([#2699](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2699)).
- Metal element-count and byte-length checks before allocation and launch
  ([#2669](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2669),
  [#2672](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2672)).

## Documentation

- README leads with the rationale and links `tenferro-examples`
  ([#2681](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2681)); shipped examples
  bind and reuse one CPU engine
  ([#2680](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2680)).

`CHANGELOG.md` lists every merged change since v0.12.0, including the
internal ones this page leaves out.

Full changelog: https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/compare/v0.12.0...v0.13.0
